Iconic black cabs (obviously) Larger multi-passenger vehicles Luxury executive cars Everyday minicabs The most dependable drivers Professional Full-time drivers who take pride in their work - no side hustles here. Gett Hospitality Order iconic black taxis at the touch of a button for guests at your hotel, restaurant, or venue. Speak to us Taxis that won’t keep anyone waiting Your guests have places to be. Order a cab with Gett and we’ll have one with you in under 4 minutes. Black cabs at the touch of a button We’ll set you up with a smart Taxi Butler device or create an account for you on our web booking platform. The choice is yours, either way it’s totally free of charge. Here’s how it works: Tap or click to order a black taxi on behalf of your guests. We send a driver to your location in under 4 minutes. Your guest enjoys a quick and comfortable ride to their destination. The passengers pay with cash or card at the end of their journey. Your trusted partner If you’re organising travel on behalf of guests, their experience should be consistent with the exceptional service they receive from your team. We work with your front-of-house staff to make sure we deliver to your standards. An account manager to serve as your single point of contact Fully licensed, professional drivers 24/7 customer support Great firms are choosing Gett We offer the fastest growing guest booking taxi service in the industry. Taxis you can trust for journeys that matter most We work with the public sector to give vulnerable passengers the service they need. Accessible taxis and intuitive technology that keep every journey safe, transparent, and on time. Talk to our team Peace of mind, from pickup to drop-off We don’t compromise on safety. Our taxi booking platform gives you full visibility of every single journey in real time, and we only work with fully licensed and vetted professional drivers. Professional drivers and enhanced safeguarding standards. Live journey tracking. 24/7 customer support. Trusted by current public sector partners including London borough councils, NHS Trusts, and more. Better value, better service Make smarter decisions by tracking bookings and costs in one place. Choose from a range of affordable, accessible vehicle options to strike the balance between duty of care and value for money. A range of accessible vehicles to suit every need and budget. Carpool and group travel options. Set spending limits and travel policies. Billing consolidated into one monthly invoice. A digital platform that saves time, money, and stress Bring vital transport services into the 21st century with Gett’s digital booking platform. Reduce costly and unnecessary admin and free up your team to focus more on the communities they serve. Automate outdated processes. Book and manage rides in bulk. Simplify billing and finance admin. Maintain oversight with regular data reports. “What I like when using transportation services is the prompt service. I know Gett will deal with my queries swiftly. They have been very helpful over the years.” Simon Ramage Associate Director, Camden and Islington NHS Foundation Trust Ready for smarter, safer taxis? There’s a better way to deliver quality transport for passengers who need it the most. Get in touch with our team and get started today.
